title: WDD Python Packaging & Entrypoint
description: Implement the `pyproject.toml` and basic package structure (`lib/wdd/__init__.py`, `lib/wdd/cli.py`) so that the `wdd` CLI is installable and executable. This allows the README quickstart (`python -m wdd`) to actually function.

requirements.packaging: Create a modern `pyproject.toml` declaring the `wdd` package and console scripts.
requirements.cli_stub: `cli.py` should implement an argparse stub for commands: `init`, `compile`, `replay`, `sweep`, `validate`, `keygen`.

failure_modes: FAIL: Setting up outdated `setup.py` instead of `pyproject.toml`.
